Yes. **This one adds something materially different**, and your examples make the Adams framework much more concrete.

## Source: Kyle Adams — *On the Metrical Techniques of Flow in Rap Music*

Adams gives us a much cleaner definition of the thing we keep calling **“making every syllable part of the percussion.”**

He divides flow into distinct variables rather than treating it as one fuzzy quality. His metrical variables are **placement of rhyming syllables, placement of accented syllables, correspondence between syntax and measures, and syllables per beat**. His articulative variables are **legato/staccato, consonant articulation, and how early or late a syllable begins relative to the beat**. citeturn597462view0

That distinction is huge.
